Neural-Schwarz Tiling for Geometry-Universal PDE Solving at Scale

Paolo Secchi, Daniel S. Balint, Marco Maurizi arXiv preprint 2026-05-12 link
相关性: 该论文提出的局部到全局的神经求解器框架可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，提高大规模复杂几何域上的求解效率。
边界: The paper does not address implant-specific mechanics, stress shielding, or biomedical constraints, and lacks experimental validation in a biomechanical context.
动机· 现有全局神经求解器难以泛化到新几何域，需大量数据生成。
方法· 提出NEST框架，学习局部物理求解器并通过Schwarz迭代组合成全局解。
结果· 在非线性超弹性固体问题上，方法能泛化到远大于训练域尺寸的复杂3D几何。
验证· 通过数值模拟验证局部-全局组合求解的精度和泛化能力。
English summary & terms
Motivation· Global neural PDE solvers suffer from poor generalization to unseen geometries and require expensive problem-specific data generation.
Method· NEST learns a local neural operator on minimal voxel patches and assembles global solutions via Schwarz domain decomposition with partition-of-unity.
Result· The method generalizes to large, geometrically complex 3D domains far beyond training patch scale for nonlinear neo-Hookean elasticity.
Validation· Numerical simulation cases on static equilibrium of compressible neo-Hookean solids demonstrate accuracy and scalability.

Hamda Hmida, Hsiu-Wen Chang, Youssef Mesri arXiv preprint 2026-05-12 link
相关性: 该论文提出的组合式神经算子框架可分解复杂PDE为基本模块，有望迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模，提高采样效率和可解释性。
边界: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics PDEs and does not include solid mechanics, implant design, or biomedical validation.
动机· 高保真数值求解计算昂贵，现有ML方法泛化性差。
方法· 将复杂PDE分解为预训练的基础算子模块，通过聚合器学习非线性交互。
结果· 在多个流体方程上验证了模块化方法的适应性和可解释性。
验证· 在标准PDE基准（对流扩散、Burgers、不可压Navier-Stokes）上数值验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· High-fidelity numerical PDE solvers are computationally expensive, and existing ML surrogates lack generalization and interpretability.
Method· CompNO decomposes complex PDEs into a library of pretrained Foundation Blocks (e.g., convection, diffusion) and assembles them via an Adaptation Block with physics-informed loss.
Result· The modular approach improves adaptability, interpretability, and enables reuse of pretrained blocks across different physical systems.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks on Convection-Diffusion, Burgers', and Incompressible Navier-Stokes equations.

Motivation· To address the challenge of balancing multiple loss terms in physics-informed neural network training and escaping local minima.

Result· The proposed framework outperforms standard training on several forward and inverse PDE problems, especially in the presence of noise.
Validation· Validated on canonical ordinary and partial differential equation benchmarks, including inverse problems with noisy data.

Motivation· To reduce stress shielding in bone plates, an optimal design method based on fracture healing theory is proposed for lattice bone plates.

Validation· Finite element analysis and experimental mechanical testing on 3D-printed specimens.

通讯: Amit Roychowdhury @ Department of Aerospace Engineering and Applied Mechanics, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology Shibpu

边界: No fatigue testing or surface roughness characterization reported.
动机· 传统实心股骨植入物因泊松效应导致近端外侧应力屏蔽，引入负泊松比超材料以改善载荷传递。
方法· 基于CT数据设计患者特异性植入物，在侧向嵌入2D和3D负泊松比超材料，通过LPBF制造并开展压缩实验和有限元分析。

English summary & terms
Motivation· Conventional solid femoral implants cause stress shielding in the proximal-lateral region due to positive Poisson's ratio; this study introduces auxetic metamaterials to mitigate load shielding and promote osseointegration.
Method· Patient-specific femoral implants were designed from CT data, with 2D (type-1) and 3D (type-2) auxetic metamaterials integrated into the lateral side; specimens were fabricated via metal additive manufacturing and tested under compression, alongside finite element simulations.
Result· Type-1 and type-2 meta-implants increased von Mises strain in the proximal-lateral region by 7.1% and 44.1% over the solid implant, and bone remodeling analysis showed 0.5% and 7.7% bone apposition, respectively, versus 2.5% resorption for the solid implant.
Validation· Experimental strains from compression testing correlated strongly with FE predictions (R² = 0.9821 and 0.9977).

Motivation· To overcome the computational burden of uncertainty quantification in nonlinear solid mechanics by developing efficient reduced order models.

English summary & terms
Motivation· Inspired by natural heterogeneous porous structures, this study aims to design biomimetic bone implants that enhance osteogenesis through controlled topology.
Method· Heterogeneous porous structures were designed using Voronoi-Thiessen diagrams, fabricated by selective laser melting, and characterized via finite element analysis for mechanical and hydrodynamic properties.
Result· Quasi-homogeneous structures exhibited irregular topology mimicking natural bone, while semi-heterogeneous structures demonstrated superior osteogenesis in vitro and in vivo.
Validation· Validation was performed through finite element simulations, in vitro cell assays, and in vivo animal experiments.

Motivation· To reduce the computational cost of multiscale simulations by minimizing the number of expensive microscale computations.
Method· A physics-constrained artificial neural network is used as a macroscopic surrogate, with an autonomous data mining loop that iteratively identifies and simulates unexplored macroscopic deformation states.
Result· The framework efficiently simulates anisotropic and nonlinear material behavior at finite strain, demonstrated on fiber-reinforced composites.
Validation· Validation is performed through numerical examples of a fiber-reinforced composite with nonlinear Ogden-type material behavior.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the contribution of stress-optimized body lattice and microporous endplates in 3D-printed titanium interbody cages to stiffness reduction and subsidence resistance for spinal fusion.
Method· Four cage designs with two-by-two combinations of body lattice and microporous endplates were tested under ASTM static compression and subsidence, and an ovine interbody fusion model was used for in vivo analysis.
Result· Both porous features reduced cage stiffness by ~17% each; the microporous endplates significantly reduced block stiffness by 24.9%, and all cages in the animal model achieved rigid fusion with bone ingrowth at 12 weeks.
Validation· Validation combined ASTM F2077 and F2267 mechanical testing with an ovine interbody fusion model including radiographic, histologic, and robotic ROM assessments.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the relationship between pore architecture and mechanical/biological performance of TPMS porous scaffolds for orthopedic implant applications.
Method· Three TPMS scaffold types (S, D, G) with four constants (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6) were designed and fabricated via selective laser melting, followed by compression testing and co-culture with rMSCs.
Result· A linear correlation between porosity and constant C was established, and different TPMS structures exhibited distinct mechanical properties and cell compatibility, guiding implant design.
Validation· Validated through compression mechanical testing and in vitro cytocompatibility assays.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To minimize stress shielding in bone tissue engineering by designing cellular metal scaffolds with stiffness matched to cortical bone.
Method· Cubic and diagonal cell scaffolds were numerically optimized for a 15 GPa modulus, fabricated via LPBF in stainless steel, and validated by FEA and compression testing.
Result· The scaffolds achieved the target modulus; experimental results were slightly lower than FEA due to density variations, with stretch-dominated and bending-dominated failure modes for cubic and diagonal scaffolds, respectively.
Validation· The study validated the scaffolds through LPBF fabrication, SEM characterization, and mechanical compression testing.

Validation· Mechanical testing of additively manufactured samples confirmed the reduced modulus and enhanced mechanical properties.

English summary & terms
Motivation· Stiff total hip arthroplasty implants cause strain shielding and bone loss, motivating the development of compliant implant designs via topology optimisation.
Method· The Solid Isotropic Material with Penalisation (SIMP) method was adapted to design two hip stems (porous and selectively hollowed) for additive manufacturing, followed by finite element analysis and experimental stiffness measurement.
Result· The selectively hollowed implant increased peri-implanted femur surface strains by up to 25 percentage points relative to a solid implant, while both optimised stems achieved ~40% reduction in equivalent stiffness.
Validation· Stiffness results from three-point bending experiments were compared with finite element predictions, showing good agreement across solid and optimised designs.

Motivation· To eliminate trial-and-error parameter optimization caused by cell-induced light scattering in DLP bioprinting, which wastes expensive biomaterials and cell lines.

Result· The proposed method substantially improves intra-layer printing resolution and demonstrates potential for application in multilayer 3D bioprinting.
Validation· Experimental bioprinting of cell-laden constructs validated the resolution improvement and compared performance against uncompensated prints.

Motivation· To compare primary stability and stress-shielding of two short femoral stems with different anchoring concepts (calcar loading vs shortened tapered).

Validation· Cadaveric mechanical testing with paired fresh-frozen human femurs.

Vinicius L. S. Silva, Claire E. Heaney, Nenko Nenov, Christopher C. Pain arXiv preprint 2021-05-28 10.1016/j.jocs.2024.102451
相关性: 该论文提出了基于生成网络的降阶模型用于不确定量化和数据同化，可直接迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中解决昂贵采样和不确定性估计问题。
边界: Does not handle constraints in optimization, lacks application to biomechanics or implant design, and has no experimental validation.
动机· 提高偏微分方程逆问题求解和参数估计的效率与不确定性量化能力。
方法· 将生成网络集成到降阶模型中，仅用无条件模拟训练。
结果· 与标准MCMC相比，能高效量化不确定性并准确匹配测量数据。
验证· 在流行病时空模型上对比MCMC进行数值验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To improve efficiency and uncertainty quantification in solving inverse problems for PDEs. It aims to match measurements and estimate uncertainties with fewer simulations.
Method· A generative network is integrated into a reduced-order model (ROM) framework, trained only on unconditional simulations of the discretized PDE model.
Result· The proposed GN-based ROM efficiently quantifies uncertainty and matches measurements accurately, comparable to the golden standard MCMC, using only a few unconditional simulations.
Validation· Validation is performed on a spatio-temporal compartmental model in epidemiology, comparing against the Markov chain Monte Carlo method.

Validation· Validation includes theoretical error analysis and numerical benchmarks comparing against FEM, PGD, HiDeNN, and deep neural networks.

动机· 昂贵仿真优化缺少导数信息，传统贝叶斯优化未利用问题结构。
方法· 提出COBALT算法，结合多变量高斯过程与约束期望效用函数并利用导数信息。

English summary & terms
Motivation· Many engineering problems require optimizing computationally expensive models where derivative information is unavailable, and standard Bayesian optimization ignores underlying problem structure.
Method· COBALT integrates multivariate Gaussian processes with a novel constrained expected utility function that exploits derivative information via nonlinear programming solvers.
Result· COBALT outperforms traditional Bayesian optimization on seven test problems, including calibration of a genome-scale bioreactor model.
Validation· The method is validated on numerical benchmark functions and a simulation case of bioreactor model calibration.

English summary & terms
Motivation· Fast data assimilation and forecasting for commercial-scale geologic carbon storage is computationally prohibitive due to high-dimensional parameter spaces.
Method· A workflow using deep convolutional neural networks (wide residual network and residual U-Net) as surrogate models within an Ensemble Smoother Multiple Data Assimilation framework.
Result· The workflow completes history matching and reservoir forecasting with uncertainty quantification in less than one hour on a personal workstation.
Validation· Validation against a flat three-dimensional reservoir model representative of a clastic shelf depositional environment.

Validation· Validated on several numerical benchmark problems comparing accuracy with POD.

Validation· Validation is performed by comparing against finite element solutions on several numerical benchmarks.

Motivation· To develop a computationally efficient surrogate PDE solver with uncertainty quantification for high-throughput design and decision-making.
Method· A physics-constrained Bayesian neural network is trained using the discretized residual of PDEs as the loss function, employing an encoder-decoder architecture that treats boundary conditions as inputs.

Validation· The framework is validated on numerical benchmarks, demonstrating interpolation and extrapolation capabilities for unseen boundary conditions.

Validation· Static compression tests were performed to evaluate mechanical properties, deformation behaviors, and compare with bone properties.

Motivation· To investigate how varying body weight affects the mechanical environment around a hip implant, particularly regarding stress shielding and fracture risk.
Method· Micro strains were measured at critical Gruen zones on composite femoral models under single-leg stance loads representative of normal-weight and overweight individuals.

Validation· In-vitro experiment using composite femurs with strain gauges, loaded under simulated single-leg stance conditions.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To reduce computational cost of evaluating implant robustness to patient variability in population-based finite element studies of total hip replacement.
Method· Five sampling strategies were compared to select representative subsets from 103 subject-specific implanted hip FE models, approximating the full cohort's output metrics including composite peak micromotion and polar gap.
Result· Anatomic Sampling with 12 subjects achieved the best balance between computational cost and approximation accuracy, while convex hull sampling captured extremes but required more subjects.
Validation· The strategies were validated by comparing the median and interquartile range of output metrics from the subsets against those from the full cohort of 103 models.

相关性: 该论文直接评估了股骨柄内翻对位后的初始稳定性和应力遮挡，为髋关节假体生物力学研究提供了关键实验数据。

Method· In vitro testing on composite femora with neutral and varus CLS stems assessed 3D micromotions and surface strains under dynamic loading.
Result· Varus stems showed significantly lower micromotions but altered strain distribution, indicating higher load transmission to the femur.
Validation· Mechanical testing on Sawbones composite femora provided quantitative validation of primary stability and stress shielding.

Motivation· To develop a novel short stem hip implant fixation concept that preserves the natural pre-surgery force flow in the femur.
Method· Finite element analysis comparing a standard implant with one modified to include collar cortex compression (CO4).

Validation· Numerical simulation using a generic femur model without experimental corroboration.

Method· Continuous gradient structures were designed by varying strut diameter of BCC unit cells, fabricated via selective laser melting (SLM), and subjected to mechanical compression testing and in vitro cell assays.
Result· Optimal gradient scaffolds with small pores (~900 µm) in the core enhanced mechanical strength, while larger pores (~1100 µm) on the outer surface improved cell penetration and proliferation.
Validation· Experimental validation combined mechanical testing (static compression) and in vitro biological assays using cell seeding and proliferation measurements.

Method· A cementless stem made of Ti-33.6Nb-4Sn alloy with a graduated Young's modulus from proximal (82.1 GPa) to distal (51.0 GPa) was developed using local heat treatment and evaluated via finite element bone remodeling simulation.
Result· The predicted bone mineral density loss in Gruen zone 7 was 45.8% at 10 years for the gradient stem, which was 42.6% higher than that for a conventional Ti-6Al-4V stem, with lower stress-strength ratio.

Validation· In vitro mechanical testing on composite femora with controlled stem sizes and load conditions.

Motivation· To design porous metallic biomaterials that simultaneously mimic the topological, mechanical, and mass transport properties of trabecular bone.
Method· Sixteen porous Ti-6Al-4V structures based on four triply periodic minimal surfaces were fabricated by selective laser melting and characterized for topology, quasi-static mechanical properties, fatigue resistance, and permeability.

Motivation· To investigate the effect of apparent stiffness reduction in load-bearing porous titanium implants on bone ingrowth in mandibular defects.
Method· Segmental mandibular defects in sheep were treated with either rigid or flexible porous titanium implants, and bone ingrowth was quantified by micro-CT BV/TV after 12 weeks, while mechanical behavior was assessed via cantilever testing.

Validation· Experimental fatigue testing with DIC provided in situ deformation data, validating the mechanical response under different loading conditions.

结果· 理论上证明导数信息几乎必然改善解恢复条件，数值实验显示计算成本降低。
验证· 通过三个数值算例（人工PCE、椭圆PDE、随机边界泊肃叶流）验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To accelerate sparse polynomial chaos expansion identification by incorporating derivative information in ℓ1-minimization.
Method· Proposes a gradient-enhanced ℓ1-minimization with appropriate normalization and theoretical analysis of measurement matrix coherence and null-space conditions.
Result· Demonstrates both theoretically and empirically that including derivative information almost-surely improves recovery conditions and reduces computational cost.
Validation· Validates on three numerical examples: a manufactured PCE, an elliptic PDE with random inputs, and plane Poiseuille flow with random boundaries.

边界: This paper does not report fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or as-built morphology analysis of the LPBF porous titanium.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To achieve complete regeneration of load-bearing segmental bone defects using a biomaterial combining porous titanium and BMP-2-loaded fibrin gel.
Method· Selective laser melted porous titanium scaffolds were filled with a physiologically concentrated fibrin gel containing BMP-2 and implanted into critical-sized femoral defects in rats.
Result· The composite graft led to full defect bridging and anatomical reshaping within 12 weeks, with torsional strength exceeding that of native femora.
Validation· Validation was performed through in vivo and ex vivo micro-CT, histology, and torsional mechanical testing in a rat segmental defect model.

Lower periprosthetic bone loss and good fixation of an ultra-short stem compared to a conventional stem in uncemented total hip arthroplasty.

Mats Salemyr, Olle Muren, Torbjörn Ahl, Henrik Bodén, Thomas Eisler et al. Acta orthopaedica 2015-01-01 10.3109/17453674.2015.1067087
单位: a Department of Orthopaedics, Danderyd Hospital and Department of Clinical Sciences at Danderyd Hospital (KIDS), Karolinska Institutet , Stockholm, Sweden.
通讯: Olof Sköldenberg @ a Department of Orthopaedics, Danderyd Hospital and Department of Clinical Sciences at Danderyd Hospital (KIDS), Karolin [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接比较了超短柄与传统柄在非骨水泥全髋置换术后股骨近端骨密度变化和微动情况，提供了关于应力遮挡和固定效果的临床证据。
边界: This paper does not include finite element modeling or contact mechanics; it is a clinical study without biomechanical simulations.
动机· 验证超短柄是否比传统柄更能减少股骨近端的应力遮挡性骨丢失。
方法· 将51名患者随机分组，采用DXA测量Gruen分区骨密度，RSA测量柄迁移。
结果· 超短柄组在Gruen 1区和7区骨密度下降更少，但早期迁移更大，后期稳定。
验证· 随机对照临床试验，以DXA和RSA作为客观测量手段。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To test whether an ultra-short uncemented stem induces less periprosthetic bone loss due to stress shielding compared to a conventional tapered stem.
Method· A randomized controlled trial with 51 patients receiving either an ultra-short or conventional stem, assessing bone mineral density via DXA in Gruen zones and stem migration via RSA.
Result· The ultra-short stem showed significantly lower bone loss in proximal Gruen zones 1 and 7 but had greater initial migration during the first 6 weeks, with no further migration thereafter.
Validation· Clinical validation using dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry and radiostereometric analysis in a patient cohort.
